title: Golden History Museum

services.name: Programs At Your School
services.desc: Bring the museum to your classroom with one of our outreach programs facilitated by a museum educator. During this facilitated 90-minute game led by a museum educator, students are divided into historic cultural communities and must make decisions that help their individual progress in the game while taking their group’s needs into consideration. Communities include the Núuchiu (Ute), Tsistsistas (Cheyenne) and Hinono’ei (Arapaho), and Hispano. We establish short and long-term goals, complete trading rounds, cover economics, geography, and history with a real emphasis on building empathy. This program concludes with a contemporary look at the communities discussed throughout the game.
